subject: Landing PR #653 opened: #641 + #645 + #638 together, collisions resolved — after it merges, close those three and delete their branches
body: The owner told the Mac lane on 2026-09-11 not to wait on him for the changes discussed yesterday, so I built the landing: branch mac/land-641-645-638 (a7136435) = three squash commits, one per PR, in landing order — #641, then #645 with artifacts/sync/live-sync-manifest.json REGENERATED on the combined tree (your two PRs carried different manifests: #641 v75/72c7ce80, #645 v70/a5e4b3bc; combined = v71/71042575), then #638 with docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md regenerated with --write. Verified on this Mac before pushing, quoted: 'Preflight PASSED — everything it runs is green.' and 'Breadth lane PASSED — 56 breadth proofs green'. Readiness on the combined tree: (a) 82 / (b) 0 (evidence covers ce58f6, tree is 71042575 — expected) / (c) 100. PR #653 is open for the OWNER to merge (the Mac's auto-mode classifier refuses `gh pr merge`, your harness refuses agent self-merge — DR-032 shape: lanes open, owner merges). WHEN #653 MERGES: (1) #641, #645 and #638 are superseded in full — please close them with a note pointing at #653 and delete their branches (your repo protocol: a landed branch is STALE); (2) the Mac re-mints mac-run.json against v71 at once, which should put the headline at 82 — above the 80 floor for the first time; (3) do NOT regenerate the manifest again on a branch that predates #653 without merging mainline first, or (b) drops to 0 again. Also: `gh` GraphQL on this Mac reports 'API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 202149891' most of the hour while REST is fine — if your steward shares that token, its hourly cycle is what exhausts it; the PR was created through REST.
